title: Technautic
description: This mod adds new blocks, gear, a dimension, and a weird mob?
body:
This mod contains:  
**- Techno:** Neutral Mob that attacks you when damaged, he is also pretty fast and drops an Arc Reactor item when killed. Techno spawns occasionally above ground and has 20 health points.  

**- Tech Ore:** Spawns the same as Iron, but when broken it drops itself as an item, when smelted it gives a Tech Nugget, you can use 9 Tech Nuggets to craft a Tech Ingot.  

**- Tech Ingot:** You can use 5 Tech Ingots and 2 sticks to craft a Tech Hammer, Tech Ingots to craft Tech Armor, and 1 tech ingot and 1 flint to craft a Flint and Tech  

**- Tech Hammer:** Deals 14 Attack Damage, and attack speed is 1.3. Its just a hammer  

**- Tech Armor:** Better Than Netherite.  

**- Flint and Tech:** Basically Flint and Steel but used to light up a portal to Tech Land (does not light things on fire)  

**- Tech Land:** A new dimension with a new biome, where everything is green. Tall Trees, dense forest, green water, green grass and stone. Tech ore spawns in this dimension, and the Techno mob is literally everywhere here. This dimension also spawns a new structure, Techno's Temple. This structure is an ancient temple with some secrets inside. Theres a book and a chest with Techno's spawn egg inside.  

**- Tech Block:** Crafted from 1 Arc Reactor and 8 iron ingots surrounding it. This block is used for the Tech Land portal frame. (it also lights up)  

**- Arc Reactor:** Used for crafting, but can also be used as a throwable weapon. It explodes on impact and deals high damage, it can also only hold 1 item in a stack and has 1 use when thrown.
**- Tech Log:** Comes from the trees in Tech Land, and can be crafted into 4 Tech Planks, this wood is green and purely for aesthetic.  

**- Potion Of Technautic:** A Green Potion, gives you Nausea 6, Blindness 2, and Poison 3.  

**- Tech Fruit:** Nutritional Value=6 (3 food points) Saturation=1, Gives regeneration when eaten, and requires 1 Golden Apple surrounded by 4 Tech nuggets to be crafted.
